name: High Power Sanford Super Bright Flashlight – Slide Zoom White Laser LED Edition
description:
🔦 High Power Super Bright Flashlight – White Laser LED Edition 💥
Slide Zoom
\Light up your world with unstoppable brightness and intelligence! The High Power Super Bright Flashlight is built for those who demand power, durability, and smart technology in one compact device. Whether for camping, travel, or emergency use — this flashlight delivers unmatched performance and reliability.
✨ Unique Features & Specifications:
Ultra-Bright White Laser LED:
Equipped with a high-intensity white laser LED that produces an incredibly powerful beam — bright enough to cover long distances easily. 🌟
 Durable Aluminum Alloy Body
Crafted from premium aluminum alloy, making it strong, shockproof, scratch-resistant, and long-lasting. ⚙️
Super Zoom Function (Adjustable Focus):
Features a smooth zoom control that lets you adjust the beam — from wide floodlight to focused spotlight — ideal for both close-up and long-range lighting. 🔍
 Rechargeable via Type-C & Power Bank Support:
Comes with a fast Type-C charging port, and can even be used as a power bank to charge your smartphone or other USB devices when needed. ⚡📱
18650 High-Capacity Rechargeable Battery:
Includes a built-in 18650 lithium battery that ensures powerful and long-lasting brightness for hours of uninterrupted use. 🔋
Digital Battery Percentage Display:
Advanced LED screen display shows the exact battery level in percentage (%), so you’ll always know the remaining power and charging status — no more guessing! 💯
Built-in Compass Indicator:
Designed with a built-in compass for safe navigation during camping, hiking, or outdoor trips — perfect for adventurers! 🧭
Colorful Grip Indicator Design:
Stylish and functional multi-color grip ring adds a modern look and helps easily identify the flashlight’s operating mode. 🌈
Strong Rope Strap Included:
Comes with a durable wrist strap for easy carrying, secure grip, and added convenience during outdoor activities. 🪢
🌟 Why You’ll Love It:
Super bright and long-range beam
 Rechargeable & works as a power bank
 Digital battery display for accurate charge status
 Adjustable zoom for flexible lighting
 Compact, strong, and travel-friendly desig
📦 Package Includes:
• 1× High Power Super Bright Flashlight
 1× Type-C Charging Cable
 1× Strong Rope Strap
 1× Premium Gift Bo
⚡ Perfect For:
 Camping ⛺
 Hiking 🥾
Security Work 🚓
Night Repairing 🧰
Emergency Situations 🚨
Outdoor Adventures 🌌
 Home Use 🏠
